content: importlib.metadata.entry_points() (stdlib, 3.10+ for the group= kwarg) is sufficient for plugin/part discovery: packages register entry points in pyproject.toml under a custom group (e.g. 'databasise.parts'), and pluggy's own loader is built on top of the same mechanism. pluggy adds hook-spec/hook-impl dispatch machinery useful for hook chains, but is unnecessary overhead when parts are just named, versioned callables looked up by 'name@version' -- entry_points() plus a name->version registry dict covers the need.
